claim: Manage many projects from one Redmine instance, with per-project roles and per-project modules
Issue statuses, types and workflow transitions per issue type and role are configurable in the admin interface
Gantt chart and calendar are generated from issue start and due dates
Time can be entered at project or ticket level, with reports by user, issue type, category or activity
Custom fields exist for issues, time entries, projects and users and can be used as filters
Released under the GNU General Public License v2
Supported databases include PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite; SQLite is not for multi-user production use
MySQL requires transaction_isolation set to READ COMMITTED
The install procedure is laid out in eleven steps (application, database, dependencies, secrets, assets, schema, default data, permissions, test, login)
A new release comes about every six months
The feature list names no Kanban or agile board
Plugins and themes are listed as resources
